text: Question: My phone shows 'SIM not provisioned for voice' — how do I fix this? Answer: ### Short Answer This typically indicates a network-side provisioning issue rather than a device fault. Restart the device, toggle Airplane Mode, and if unresolved, contact care with your number so the account can be re-provisioned on the network. ### Detailed Explanation The key framing is that this is a network-side provisioning issue, not a device fault — which is why the fix sequence starts with quick device-side resets (restart, Airplane Mode toggle) that can sometimes nudge re-registration, before moving to contacting care to have the account re-provisioned directly on the network. ### Key Details | Detail | Value | |---|---| | Nature of issue | Network-side provisioning issue, not a device fault | | Quick checks | Restart device, toggle Airplane Mode | | If unresolved | Contact care with your number for account re-provisioning | ### Troubleshooting | Symptom | Possible Cause | Diagnostic Check | Recommended Action | |---|---|---|---| | 'SIM not provisioned for voice' appears | Network-side provisioning issue | Whether restart/Airplane Mode toggle clears it | Try restart and Airplane Mode toggle first | | Message persists after restart/Airplane Mode toggle | Provisioning needs to be reset from the network side | Account provisioning status | Contact care with your number so the account can be re-provisioned | ### Escalation Contacting care with your number for re-provisioning is the documented step once the device-side resets don't clear the message. ###
